reports: falling back to i.id when link is blank may store a non-url identifier (e.g. urn:uuid) as embedurl, failing the ^https?:// guard inconsistently

[advisory] the fallback 'url = i.id if url.blank? || url !~ /^https?/' assigns the entry id, which for atom feeds is commonly a non-url urn (tag:...), and topicembed.import then silently returns nil for it with no log atom feeds whose ids are urns are silently skipped every hour with no error result and no log line identifying which item was dropped

[advisory] feed items whose link resolves to blank and whose id is also non-http produce url = i.id / nil, and items with a blank or missing title flow into postcreator under skipvalidations: true. with validations skipped, a nil/blank title is not rejected by postcreator's normal validation, so malformed feed entries can create topics with empty titles (or fail inside the transaction each hour, re-enqueueing the same bad item every poll with no dead-letter or skip counter), poisoning the import stream indefinitely.
